program.name: Metro Transit Reduced Fare Program (St. Louis)
program.description:
The Metro Transit Reduced Fare Program lets eligible riders pay half price for MetroBus and MetroLink in St. Louis. The disability category is for riders whose condition means they need accessibility features to ride — not every disability qualifies, and Metro's ADA Services makes the final determination.

Once approved, you get a Reduced Fare Permit — a photo ID card, typically ready in about 10 days. Show it every time you pay your fare, or use it to buy a discounted monthly pass instead of a full-price one. Permits need periodic renewal, so plan to reapply with the same documents down the road.

The savings estimate assumes you buy a monthly pass. If you pay for each ride instead, you will still pay half price, but you will save less over a year.

To apply, you'll need proof of identity and one proof of your category: a Medicare card, a Social Security Disability or SSI award letter, VA disability documentation, proof of your age, or a disability verification completed by a professional familiar with your condition.

Contact Metro's ADA Services team at 314.982.1510 to start your Reduced Fare Permit.
